chunks: From him, from al-‘Abbās ibn ‘Āmir, from Ḥajjāj al-Khashshāb, who said:

I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام about a man who had intercourse with his wife, then she menstruated after he had finished. Should she make it one ghusl when she becomes pure, or should she perform ghusl twice? He said: She makes it one ghusl at the time of her purification.

key_terms.إِذَا طَهُرَتْ: when she becomes pure from menstruation
key_terms.عِنْدَ طُهْرِهَا: at the time of her purification
key_terms.غُسْلًا وَاحِدًا: a single ritual bath sufficient for multiple causes

ai.seo_question: Does a woman who becomes junub and then starts menstruating need one ghusl or two after becoming pure?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a woman who becomes junub through intercourse and then begins menstruation before performing ghusl. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that when she becomes pure from menstruation, one ghusl suffices for both states.
